name: @loopany/cli
description: Loopany kernel CLI + local file driver. The `loopany-kernel` bin drives @loopany/kernel against a .loopany/ workspace (the M2 demo-phase file backend); the driver is exported for reuse by the M6 conformance harness. Bare `loopany` belongs to the daemon — the CLI verbs merge into it in a later batch.
